        return 0

        int(first[6:8]),
    )

def escalate(cases: list[dict], today: str) -> list[dict]:

        case for case in cases
        if case.get("DEL_FLG", "") != "Y"
    )

    ordered_cases = sorted(
        live_cases,
        key=lambda case: case.get("CASE_ID", ""),
    )

    events: list[dict] = []
    emitted_ids: set[str] = set()

    for case in ordered_cases:
        case_id = case.get("CASE_ID", "")

            continue

        age_days = _datediff(today, case.get("OPEN_DT", ""))
        status = case.get("STAT_CD", "")

            and escalated != "Y"
            and age_days >= 7
        )

                    "entity_id": entity_id,
                    "event": "auto_escalate",
                }
            )
            emitted_ids.add(entity_id)

    return events
